description: Transcribes a local audio file (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, opus, webm, flac, aac, mp4; max 25 MB) to text with the Ezkielyna API. Default model whisper-large-v3. Optional language hint such as "id" or "en", and subtitle output (srt/vtt). Paid by audio length; counts toward the session cap.

file.description: Absolute path of the audio file, e.g. /Users/me/Downloads/voice-note.ogg.

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code of the speech, e.g. "id" (Indonesian) or "en". Empty = auto-detect.

model.description: Speech-to-text model id (default whisper-large-v3). See list_audio_models.

prompt.description: Optional hint with names or terms that appear in the audio (max 500 characters).

name: transcribe_audio
title: Suara ke teks / Transcribe audio
